introduction: Compile TypeScript projects for Rhino and Node.js, with semantic diagnostics and Source Maps.
installation: Install the signed APK from the official release alongside a compatible AutoJs6 host. Enable or activate TypeScript Engine in the plugin center, then run a .ts or .tsx project. Rhino works without Node.js Runtime; Node.js projects require that runtime plugin.
compatibility: Requires Android 7 (API 24) or newer and Chrome/WebView 119 or newer. The included compiler is TypeScript 6.0.3. Native npm addons, package install lifecycle scripts and emitDecoratorMetadata are unsupported. Public distribution follows the compatible host release; the historical acceptance records do not certify every later APK. Rhino projects compile to ES2018 and keep the `class` syntax as written, so they need AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later to run. Async functions and async generators are kept as written too, with the same version requirement.
